ns2:section.sectionText: TOPIC: "Queer Identities: Sex, Gender, and Nation in Early Modern Spain." Restricted to Teaching of Spanish or Spanish or International Studies or Global Studies major(s). All seats restricted during the early registration period. This restriction will be lifted on November 30, 2011 by 9:00 a.m. Students must meet the prerequisite requirements for this course (found in the Catalog Entry) or will be told to drop on the first day of classes. Non-registered students are not allowed to sit in or audit.
